Google Apps Script offers a powerful solution, enabling seamless digital product delivery without relying on services like Stripe. This post will explore how Google Apps Script can automate your digital commerce stack effectively, ensuring that creators can thrive with their own infrastructure.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting language that allows you to automate tasks across Google's services. For digital creators, this means you can streamline operations such as order fulfillment and customer communication without depending on traditional payment processors. In regions where services like PayPal or Stripe are unavailable, Google Apps Script becomes vital for automating processes that ensure customers receive their digital products instantly after payment. This automation reduces manual errors, improves efficiency, and enhances customer satisfaction by providing immediate access to purchased items.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for automating digital commerce with Google Apps Script involves several key components working in tandem. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments processes the crypto payment and sends a webhook to your server. This webhook triggers a Google Apps Script function, which then retrieves the order details and manages the fulfillment process. Google Sheets or Supabase serves as your order storage database, allowing you to track transactions effortlessly. This infrastructure is designed to process orders in under 30 seconds, ensuring that your customers receive their products without delay.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically built for digital creators who operate in markets where conventional payment systems fail. From writers and course creators to software developers and musicians, the need for reliable, automated digital delivery is universal. By implementing Google Apps Script in your commerce stack, you gain independence from restrictive platforms. This solution empowers you to directly manage your sales and customer interactions, ultimately allowing you to focus more on creating and less on troubleshooting payment issues.
Google Apps Script can handle complex automation without the need for expensive software.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To effectively automate your digital commerce, several components must be correctly integrated. Google Apps Script acts as the backbone, handling the logic and responding to webhooks. NOWPayments is responsible for verifying crypto transactions and triggering the fulfillment process. Google Sheets or Supabase serves as the order management system, storing essential details about each transaction. Additionally, using Resend or Gmail ensures that customers receive their download links promptly after payment confirmation. Together, these elements create a streamlined workflow that enhances your operational efficiency.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this automation system, start by setting up your NOWPayments account and obtaining your API keys. Next, create a Google Sheet or a Supabase instance to serve as your order storage. Write your Google Apps Script functions to handle webhooks and manage order fulfillment. Test the integration thoroughly to ensure that all components work harmoniously. Finally, load your digital products and start selling through your newly established platform. For a ready-to-use solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital delivery works through a specific technical sequence that eliminates every manual step. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain for incoming transactions to your configured wallet address. When a transaction receives the configured number of on-chain confirmations — typically one confirmation on Tron, which takes under 60 seconds — NOWPayments sends an HTTP POST request to the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App receives this request, validates the webhook signature against the secret key you configured, reads the payment data, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your database, and sends the delivery email with a time-limited download link.
NOWPayments enables you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees.

Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your backend first — Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible via HTTP POST before configuring NOWPayments. Set the IPN webhook URL in your NOWPayments account settings to point to your backend endpoint. Set the IPN secret key in both NOWPayments and your backend configuration — this is the string that both sides use to verify webhook authenticity. Upload your product files to the configured delivery storage — Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive — with the paths matching your backend configuration. Complete a real mainnet transaction and check your backend logs to confirm the webhook was received, the signature was validated, the transaction was verified on-chain, the order was logged, and the delivery email was sent. Monitor the order database daily for the first week.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated delivery happens when a payment processor like NOWPayments confirms a transaction. The confirmation triggers a webhook that prompts a script to send the download link to the customer immediately, ensuring a smooth transaction experience.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is a real-time notification sent by a payment processor to your server when an event occurs, such as a completed payment. This notification triggers your backend script to process the order and fulfill it automatically.
Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?
Yes, by using Google Apps Script, you can configure your system to automatically send download links to customers as soon as their crypto payment is confirmed, enhancing the user experience.
What tools do I need to implement this solution?

You will need NOWPayments for payment processing, Google Apps Script for automation, and either Google Sheets or Supabase for order management. Together, these tools create a robust infrastructure for digital commerce.
